note: What a server sends when a building is destroyed. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: attacker
fields.note: The unit that destroyed it. Only an inhibitor reads it; a client reads nothing here for any other building.

revisions.note: A client takes a building the map placed away four seconds later, a turret building and the nexus included, and ignores a second BuildingDied for it; for a turret CreateTurret made it does nothing. An inhibitor stays: a client plays its destruction and raises a game event carrying attacker. A nexus falls with GameEnded.
